idea-plugin.name: Lua Insight
idea-plugin.description:
Lua support with Luanalysis type analysis, based on EmmyLua.

Independent fork: plugin ID com.weitp. Disable other Lua plugins before enabling this plugin.

Source Code | Report an Issue | Documentation

Features:
  • Syntax highlighting
    • Highlight global value
    • Highlight local/param value
    • Highlight up value
  • Code completion
    • Keyword completion
    • Basic completion
    • Type inferred based completion
  • Debugger
    • Attach Debugger(Windows only)
    • Remote Debugger(Mobdebug.lua)
  • Lua 5.4 support
  • Find usages
  • Rename
  • Go to definition
  • Go to symbol
  • Go to class
  • Go to file
  • Parameter name hints
  • Comment based type/class annotation
  • Structure view
  • Comment in/out
  • Color settings page
  • Method override line marker
  • Quick Documentation
  • Live templates
  • Postfix completion templates
  • Code formatter
  • Code intentions
  • Code inspections
  • Lua Standard Library/API
  • Region folding
  • Lua Check Tool

问题反馈请提交到 Lua Insight Issues。
